dialogues.text: Hello. What can I help you with today?
Hello. I'd like to apply for an eighteen-month family medical time loan.

Of course.
Is the loan for your own medical care, or for a family member?

Eighteen months of time credit.
Is it intended to support long-term treatment?

Yes.
She has a chronic illness and needs continued support to sustain her time.

Understood.
Please confirm that the time credit will be repaid through your future labor time.
I understand. I reviewed the time-repayment rules before coming here to apply.
(Hands over the documents) Here are my application documents.

All right.
Your documents have been registered.
Please wait for the review.

final_dialogues.text: After reviewing your documents, we've approved your loan application.
Please keep track of the repayment schedule.
I will. Thank you for the reminder.
At least... I won't have to worry for a while.
I hope your mother recovers soon.
Thank you. I should go. I need to get back to the company this afternoon.
